description: An outdoor ceremonial garden aisle at dusk, photographed at standing eye-level with a centered one-point perspective looking straight down the runway. Tall, narrow sheer white fabric panels — like gauzy column banners — rise dramatically on both sides of the aisle in symmetric pairs receding into the distance. The white panels glow softly from the warm ambient light washing across them. Between the fabric columns and along the grassy borders, masses of blush pink garden roses in full bloom and fresh green low moss or boxwood accents form lush floral borders flanking a highly polished white marble or resin runway aisle that reflects the sky and surroundings. The sky above is deep twilight blue with soft cloud formations, creating a romantic blue-and-blush contrast. Dense dark hedge walls and mature trees close in at the horizon, framing the passage. The grass is a rich dark green. Warm golden light radiates from multiple glowing sources positioned at low heights along both sides of the aisle between the fabric columns, casting warm pools across the grass and roses without any identifiable fixture shapes visible — only the effect of branching glowing spheres of amber-white light diffusing upward and outward along the path. The overall palette is twilight blue, soft blush pink, ivory white, and warm gold light. Camera is level at standing height, one-point perspective down the aisle axis. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
